tools.name: store_persistent_memory
tools.description: Stores encrypted text memory (standard padded base64 ciphertext, up to 16384 bytes decoded). Requires x402 payment. Returns the memory's id.

tools.name: read_memory
tools.description: Reads an encrypted memory by id. Requires x402 payment. 70% of the fee accrues to the memory's creator.

tools.name: extend_memory
tools.description: Extends a memory's TTL by 30 days, up to a maximum total lifetime of 365 days from creation. Requires x402 payment. An expired memory is deleted and cannot be extended.

tools.name: share_memory_key
tools.description: Free. Releases a previously creator-registered wrapped key to a reader, or the raw content key for a public document.

tools.name: register_key_release

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: send_feedback · Private data: share_memory_key · Public sink: share_memory_key, send_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: send_feedback · Private data: share_memory_key · Public sink: share_memory_key, send_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
